svg.title: CASTAWAY: title screen
svg.desc: An 8-bit console style title screen for Castaway, a lo-fi island video: a sand and gold tile logo reading CASTAWAY whose T is a palm tree, a menu with a coconut cursor, a blinking PUSH START and the command python tools/serve.py, then a demo card where a coconut falls on a hermit crab and walks off with it.
